name: Kimpton Maa-Lai Bangkok
positioning: Boutique city hotel on Langsuan Road near Lumphini Park, with modern design shaped by Thai artisanship
best_for: Travelers who want a leafy city base near Lumphini Park

facts.text: The hotel sits on Langsuan Road near Lumphini Park.
Lumphini Park is 0.3 kilometers from the hotel.
The hotel's design blends modern, linear architecture with organic materials and traditional Thai artisanship.
The hotel has one outdoor pool, on the third floor, overlooking the Langsuan garden oasis.
The hotel has a spa called amaranth spa.
The hotel has a neighbourhood-inspired eatery serving farm-to-plate food, a lobby lounge for morning coffee, and a cocktail bar.
Pets are welcome at no extra charge, whatever their size, weight or breed.
Complimentary parking is available for hotel guests.

highlights.text: The hotel's design blends modern, linear architecture with organic materials and traditional Thai artisanship.
Through the Kimpton Pets programme the hotel offers pet menus, special amenities and pet sitter services.
A rooftop terrace with city views is one of the hotel's drinking spots.
The outdoor pool is on the third floor, overlooking the Langsuan garden oasis.

considerations.text: The hotel does not offer a complimentary local area shuttle.
WhataHotel notes that premium pricing reflects the upscale Langsuan district location.
